- Agent: WebSurfer

- Agent: Planner

  -- Thought: Need exact birth year from reliable source to compare with 1939.
  -- Result: Decision to use WebSurfer to open Stewart Raffill's Wikipedia page.
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Opened https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stewart_Raffill and extracted birth year from JSON-LD metadata.
  -- Observation: Wikipedia page headline indicates "British writer and director (born 1942)".
  -- Thought: Extracted birth year 1942 from metadata.
  -- Result: Identified Stewart Raffill's birth year as 1942.
- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Compared birth years (1939 vs 1942) and concluded the final answer.
  -- Observation: Bertrand Blier (1939) vs Stewart Raffill (1942).
  -- Thought: 1939 is earlier than 1942, so Buffet Froid's director was born earlier.
  -- Result: Final answer: Buffet Froid.
